title: Cassata-Crusted Lamb Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, this recipe features lamb coated in a crispy cassata crust, served in a taco shell with a hint of zesty sauce.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
Roll out the cassata crust and coat the lamb shoulder, pressing the crust onto the meat.
Place the coated lamb on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, warm the taco shells in the oven.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the lamb into thin strips and serve in the warmed taco shells.
Drizzle the zesty sauce over the lamb and top with chopped cilantro and crushed sicilian olives.
Serve with shredded cheese on the side, if desired.
